career_profiles.title: Solar PV System Installation & Maintenance Technician
career_profiles.titleHi: सोलर पीवी सिस्टम इंस्टॉलेशन एवं मेंटेनेंस तकनीशियन
career_profiles.eligibility: Class 10th Passed (or 8th with 2yr ITI electrical background)
career_profiles.eligibilityHi: 10वीं कक्षा उत्तीर्ण (या 8वीं + 2 वर्ष का आईटीआई इलेक्ट्रिकल)
career_profiles.degreeProgression: Eligible for Diploma in Electrical/Renewable Energy (Lateral Entry 2nd Yr) -> B.Voc in Green Technology -> B.Tech Electrical.
career_profiles.safetyNote: Standardized safety training with fall arrest harnesses, insulated PPE kits, and high-voltage cutoffs under MNRE guidelines.
career_profiles.socialPerceptionRebuttal: Clean, modern engineering technology job. Government recognizes solar technicians as "Suryamitra" with high societal respect.
career_profiles.dataSource: Skill Council for Green Jobs (SCGJ) & NCVET Annual Tracer Survey

career_profiles.title: Industrial & Domestic Electrician
career_profiles.eligibilityHi: 10वीं पास (गणित और विज्ञान विषयों के साथ)
career_profiles.degreeProgression: Direct Lateral Entry into 2nd year Polytechnic Electrical Engineering -> B.Tech (Electrical) -> AMIE.
career_profiles.safetyNote: Compulsory NFPA 70E lockout-tagout (LOTO) protocols, earth fault detection, and arc flash gear.
career_profiles.socialPerceptionRebuttal: Unlike informal roadside handymen, an ITI Certified Electrician gets recognized government license (Form L) and permanent industrial job cadre.
career_profiles.dataSource: Directorate General of Training (DGT) ITI Placement Records

career_profiles.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Powertrain & Battery Service Technician
career_profiles.titleHi: इलेक्ट्रिक वाहन (EV) बैटरी एवं पॉवरट्रेन सर्विस तकनीशियन
career_profiles.degreeProgression: Polytechnic in Automobile / Mechatronics Engineering (Lateral Entry) -> B.Voc EV Technology.
career_profiles.safetyNote: Class 0 insulated toolsets (up to 1000V DC), fire containment blankets, and high-voltage isolation training.
career_profiles.socialPerceptionRebuttal: High-tech, air-conditioned service environment replacing old greasy garages with computer diagnostic scanners and digital scopes.
career_profiles.dataSource: Automotive Skills Development Council (ASDC) Skill Report

career_profiles.title: Drone Assembly, Repair & Precision Agriculture Pilot
career_profiles.titleHi: ड्रोन असेंबली, मेंटेनेंस एवं कृषि पायलट तकनीशियन
jobRoles: Drone Entrepreneur / Custom Hiring Center Operator
career_profiles.degreeProgression: Polytechnic Diploma in Electronics / Avionics -> B.Sc / B.Voc in Geoinformatics & Remote Sensing.
career_profiles.safetyNote: No heavy manual labor. Strict DGCA flight zone guidelines, automated geofencing, and fail-safe return-to-home algorithms.
career_profiles.socialPerceptionRebuttal: Held in high regard in rural and urban areas alike; recognized as a modern technical pilot commanding respect and tech admiration.
career_profiles.dataSource: Aerospace and Aviation Sector Skill Council (AASSC) Survey

career_profiles.title: CNC Machining & Precision Tooling Operator
career_profiles.titleHi: सीएनसी मशीनिंग एवं प्रिसिजन टूलिंग ऑपरेटर
career_profiles.degreeProgression: Polytechnic Diploma in Mechanical / Production Engineering (Lateral Entry) -> B.Tech Mechanical.
career_profiles.safetyNote: Fully enclosed modern machines with optical safety curtains, emergency interlocks, and coolant mist extractors.
career_profiles.socialPerceptionRebuttal: Requires mental acumen in CAD drawings, micrometers, and G-codes. Not manual hammering, but computerized high-tech machining.

career_profiles.title: Healthcare General Duty Assistant & Emergency Care Associate
career_profiles.titleHi: स्वास्थ्य सेवा जनरल ड्यूटी असिस्टेंट (GDA) एवं इमरजेंसी केयर
career_profiles.degreeProgression: Bridge course into GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery) -> B.Sc Nursing / B.Voc Hospital Administration.
career_profiles.safetyNote: Bio-safety protocols, PPE gloves, immunization shots (Hepatitis B), and sanitized hospital conditions.
career_profiles.socialPerceptionRebuttal: Viewed with deep gratitude and emotional respect by patients and communities as healthcare frontline professionals.
career_profiles.dataSource: Healthcare Sector Skill Council (HSSC) National Placement Survey

career_profiles.title: Advanced Welder & Structural Fabricator (TIG/MIG & Pipe)
career_profiles.titleHi: एडवांस्ड वेल्डर एवं स्ट्रक्चरल फैब्रिकेटर (TIG/MIG/पाइप वेल्डिंग)
career_profiles.degreeProgression: Polytechnic Diploma in Metallurgy / Production Engineering -> B.Voc Welding Tech -> CSWIP Inspector Certification.
career_profiles.safetyNote: Auto-darkening electronic welding helmets, leather aprons, fume exhaust vents, and heat-resistant spats.
career_profiles.socialPerceptionRebuttal: High-skilled TIG welders earn comparable or higher salaries than average corporate white-collar desk workers, with massive Gulf overseas exportability.
career_profiles.dataSource: Indian Welding Society (IWS) & DGT Skill Surveys

career_profiles.title: IT Hardware, Networking & Cybersecurity Support Assistant
career_profiles.titleHi: आईटी हार्डवेयर, नेटवर्किंग एवं साइबर सुरक्षा सपोर्ट सहायक
career_profiles.degreeProgression: Polytechnic Diploma in Computer Science / IT (Lateral Entry) -> BCA -> MCA / B.Tech CSE.
career_profiles.safetyNote: Completely indoor, air-conditioned corporate and office environment. Zero physical hazard.
career_profiles.socialPerceptionRebuttal: Parents seeking prestigious "computer desk jobs" find this ideal; clean professional corporate setting with immediate post-course employment.
career_profiles.dataSource: IT-ITeS Sector Skills Council (NASSCOM) Employability Report

career_profiles.title: Food Processing, Quality Testing & Dairy Plant Technician
career_profiles.titleHi: खाद्य प्रसंस्करण, गुणवत्ता जांच एवं डेयरी प्लांट तकनीशियन

salary.selfEmployedPotential: ₹50,000 - ₹1,30,000 / month (PMFME Supported Food Brand / Dairy Unit)

jobRoles: Micro-Food Enterprise Owner (Pickles, Spices, Bakery, Dairy)
career_profiles.degreeProgression: Polytechnic Diploma in Food Technology -> B.Voc Food Processing -> B.Sc Food Tech.
career_profiles.safetyNote: Sterile, clean sanitary conditions following FSSAI and HACCP standards.
career_profiles.socialPerceptionRebuttal: Directly aligns with agricultural families wanting their children to add value to farming produce without migrating far.
career_profiles.dataSource: Food Industry Capacity & Skill Initiative (FICSI) Report

career_profiles.title: Automotive Service, Engine Overhaul & Diagnostics Specialist
career_profiles.titleHi: ऑटोमोटिव सर्विस, इंजन ओवरहाल एवं डायग्नोस्टिक्स विशेषज्ञ
career_profiles.degreeProgression: Polytechnic Diploma in Automobile Engineering (Lateral Entry) -> B.Voc Automobile.
career_profiles.safetyNote: Hydraulic ramp locks, eye protection shields, and exhaust ventilation hoses.
career_profiles.socialPerceptionRebuttal: Authorized dealership jobs provide formal branded uniforms, air-conditioned service lounges, health insurance, and structured annual increments.
career_profiles.dataSource: Automotive Skills Development Council (ASDC) Placement Tracer

career_profiles.title: Beauty, Hair Styling & Wellness Therapy Associate
career_profiles.titleHi: ब्यूटी, हेयर स्टाइलिंग एवं वेलनेस थेरेपी एसोसिएट

salary.selfEmployedPotential: ₹40,000 - ₹1,50,000 / month (Bridal Season Earnings can exceed ₹2-3 Lakhs)

career_profiles.degreeProgression: Advanced Diploma in Cosmetology & Wellness -> B.Voc in Cosmetology & Aesthetic Sciences.
career_profiles.safetyNote: Dermatologically tested cosmetic kits, hygiene autoclaves, and skin-patch test compliance.
career_profiles.socialPerceptionRebuttal: Bridal artists and professional cosmetologists are celebrated in wedding seasons and society with high cash flow and independent entrepreneurial dignity.

career_profiles.title: Apparel Pattern Making & Computerized Sewing Machine Operator
career_profiles.titleHi: परिधान पैटर्न मेकिंग एवं कम्प्यूटरीकृत सिलाई मशीन ऑपरेटर
career_profiles.degreeProgression: Polytechnic Diploma in Garment Manufacturing / Fashion Technology -> B.Voc Fashion Design.
career_profiles.safetyNote: Finger guards on needles, eye shields, dust masks, and ergonomic seating.
career_profiles.socialPerceptionRebuttal: High demand for specialized tailoring and designer boutiques ensures you can earn right from your village or town with minimal capital.
career_profiles.dataSource: Apparel Made-Ups and Home Furnishing Sector Skill Council (AMHSSC)

career_skills.name: TIG & MIG Shielded Arc Welding

career_skills.name: High-Voltage Safety & PPE Compliance

career_skills.name: Patient Vital Monitoring & First Aid
career_skills.description: Taking blood pressure, pulse oximetry, sterile dressing, and patient emergency evacuation.

career_skills.name: Client Career Consultation & Mediation
career_skills.description: Active listening, empathy, conflict resolution between youth aspirations and parental anxieties.
